subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The Business Case for Accessibility
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Business Case for Accessibility.

hook.text: A company ignores accessibility. A lawsuit costs them $6 million. The fix would have cost $50,000.

buildup.text: Accessibility lawsuits have surged. Over 4,000 digital accessibility cases were filed in the US in 2023 alone.

discovery.text: Beyond legal risk, accessible products reach a larger market—the disability community has $13 trillion in spending.

twist.text: Accessibility also improves SEO. Search engines rely on the same semantic structure that screen readers use.

climax.text: After an accessibility overhaul, a retailer sees 12% more traffic and zero legal complaints.

punchline.text: Accessibility is a legal requirement, a market opportunity, and an SEO boost.

quiz.question: How does accessibility improve SEO?
options: Search engines use the same semantic structure as screen readers
